implementation.matcher: repository-local SIGFM API; no alternative matcher

score_contract.zero: valid matcher result and distinct from error

exception_containment: all exceptions crossing sigfm_extract, keypoint count, match and destroy calls are contained at the C ABI
allowed_persistent_fields: bounded timing value if later justified
forbidden_persistent_material: keypoint coordinates, angles, scales or descriptor arrays

lifetime.sigfm_objects: ephemeral owned handles destroyed after comparisons
lifetime.zeroization_limit: complete erasure of allocator copies and OpenCV-internal allocations cannot be guaranteed by the wrapper
